/datum/reagent/halon.name: Halon
/datum/reagent/halon.description: A fire suppression gas that removes oxygen and cools down the area

/datum/reagent/healium.name: Healium
/datum/reagent/healium.description: A powerful sleeping agent with healing properties

/datum/reagent/hypernoblium.name: Hyper-Noblium
/datum/reagent/hypernoblium.description: A suppressive gas that stops gas reactions on those who inhale it.

/datum/reagent/nitrium_high_metabolizati.name: Nitrosyl plasmide
/datum/reagent/nitrium_high_metabolizati.description: A highly reactive byproduct that stops you from sleeping, while dealing increasing toxin damage over time.

/datum/reagent/nitrium_low_metabolizatio.name: Nitrium
/datum/reagent/nitrium_low_metabolizatio.description: A highly reactive gas that makes you feel faster.

/datum/reagent/pluoxium.name: Pluoxium
/datum/reagent/pluoxium.description: A gas that is eight times more efficient than O2 at lung diffusion with organ healing properties on sleeping patients.

/datum/reagent/zauker.name: Zauker
/datum/reagent/zauker.description: An unstable gas that is toxic to all living beings.

/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/helbital.name: Helbital
/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/helbital.description: Named after the norse goddess Hel, this medicine heals the patient's bruises the closer they are to death. Patients will find the medicine 'aids' their healing if not near death by causing asphyxiation.

/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/libital.name: Libital
/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/libital.description: A bruise reliever. Does minor liver damage.

/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/probital.name: Probital
/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/probital.description: Originally developed as a prototype-gym supliment for those looking for quick workout turnover, this oral medication quickly repairs broken muscle tissue but causes lactic acid buildup, tiring the patient. Overdosing can cause extreme drowsiness. An Influx of nutrients promotes the muscle repair even further.

/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/lenturi.name: Lenturi
/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/lenturi.description: Used to treat burns. Makes you move slower while it is in your system. Applies stomach damage when it leaves your system.

/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/aiuri.name: Aiuri
/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/aiuri.description: Used to treat burns. Does minor eye damage.

/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/hercuri.name: Hercuri
/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/hercuri.description: Not to be confused with element Mercury, this medicine excels in reverting effects of dangerous high-temperature environments. Prolonged exposure can cause hypothermia.

/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/convermol.name: Convermol
/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/convermol.description: Restores oxygen deprivation while producing a lesser amount of toxic byproducts. Both scale with exposure to the drug and current amount of oxygen deprivation. Overdose causes toxic byproducts regardless of oxygen deprivation.

/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/tirimol.name: Tirimol
/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/tirimol.description: An oxygen deprivation medication that causes fatigue. Prolonged exposure causes the patient to fall asleep once the medicine metabolizes.

/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/seiver.name: Seiver
/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/seiver.description: A medicine that shifts functionality based on temperature. Hotter temperatures will heal more toxicity, while colder temperatures will heal larger amounts of toxicity but only while the patient is irradiated. Damages the heart.

/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/multiver.name: Multiver
/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/multiver.description: A chem-purger that becomes more effective the more unique medicines present. Slightly heals toxicity but causes lung damage (mitigatable by unique medicines).

/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/syriniver.name: Syriniver
/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/syriniver.description: A potent antidote for intravenous use with a narrow therapeutic index, it is considered an active prodrug of musiver.

/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/musiver.name: Musiver
/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/musiver.description: The active metabolite of syriniver. Causes muscle weakness on overdose

/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/synthflesh.name: Synthflesh
/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/synthflesh.description: Heals brute and burn damage at the cost of toxicity (66% of damage healed). 100u or more can restore corpses husked by burns. Touch application only.

/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/penthrite.name: Penthrite
/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/penthrite.description: An expensive medicine that aids with pumping blood around the body even without a heart, and prevents the heart from slowing down. Mixing it with epinephrine or atropine will cause an explosion.

/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/synthflesh/bi.name: Biocellulose
/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/synthflesh/bi.description: A weaker, biological version of synthflesh that heals brute and burn, at the cost of causing more toxin damage, and being unable to unhusk. Touch application only.

/datum/reagent/catalyst_agent/speed/medi.name: Palladium Synthate Catalyst
/datum/reagent/catalyst_agent/speed/medi.description: This catalyst reagent will speed up all medicine reactions that it shares a beaker with by a dramatic amount.

/datum/reagent/drug/space_drugs.name: Space Drugs
/datum/reagent/drug/space_drugs.description: An illegal chemical compound used as drug.

/datum/reagent/drug/cannabis.name: Cannabis
/datum/reagent/drug/cannabis.description: A psychoactive drug from the Cannabis plant used for recreational purposes.

/datum/reagent/drug/nicotine.name: Nicotine
/datum/reagent/drug/nicotine.description: Slightly reduces stun times. If overdosed it will deal toxin and oxygen damage.

/datum/reagent/drug/krokodil.name: Krokodil
/datum/reagent/drug/krokodil.description: Cools and calms you down. If overdosed it will deal significant Brain and Toxin damage.

/datum/reagent/drug/methamphetamine.name: Methamphetamine
/datum/reagent/drug/methamphetamine.description: Reduces stun times by about 300%, speeds the user up, and allows the user to quickly recover stamina while dealing a small amount of Brain damage. If overdosed the subject will move randomly, laugh randomly, drop items and suffer from Toxin and Brain damage. If addicted the subject will constantly jitter and drool, before becoming dizzy and losing motor control and eventually suffer heavy toxin damage.

/datum/reagent/drug/methamphetamine/robo.name: Positronic Excitement Salts
/datum/reagent/drug/methamphetamine/robo.description: An experimental excitement chemical for synthetic life, this produces a similar effect to methamphetamine, but on robots.

/datum/reagent/drug/bath_salts.name: Bath Salts
/datum/reagent/drug/bath_salts.description: Makes you impervious to stuns and grants a stamina regeneration buff, but you will be a nearly uncontrollable tramp-bearded raving lunatic.

/datum/reagent/drug/aranesp.name: Aranesp
/datum/reagent/drug/aranesp.description: Amps you up, gets you going, and rapidly restores stamina damage. Side effects include breathlessness and toxicity.

/datum/reagent/drug/happiness.name: Happiness
/datum/reagent/drug/happiness.description: Fills you with ecstasic numbness and causes minor brain damage. Highly addictive. If overdosed causes sudden mood swings.

/datum/reagent/drug/pumpup.name: Pump-Up
/datum/reagent/drug/pumpup.description: Take on the world! A fast acting, hard hitting drug that pushes the limit on what you can handle.

/datum/reagent/drug/maint/powder.name: Maintenance Powder
/datum/reagent/drug/maint/powder.description: An unknown powder that you most likely gotten from an assistant, a bored chemist... or cooked yourself. It is a refined form of tar that enhances your mental ability, making you learn stuff a lot faster.

/datum/reagent/drug/maint/sludge.name: Maintenance Sludge
/datum/reagent/drug/maint/sludge.description: An unknown sludge that you most likely gotten from an assistant, a bored chemist... or cooked yourself. Half refined, it fills your body with itself, making it more resistant to wounds, but causes toxins to accumulate.

/datum/reagent/drug/maint/tar.name: Maintenance Tar
/datum/reagent/drug/maint/tar.description: An unknown tar that you most likely gotten from an assistant, a bored chemist... or cooked yourself. Raw tar, straight from the floor. It can help you with escaping bad situations at the cost of liver damage.

/datum/reagent/drug/mushroomhallucinogen.name: Mushroom Hallucinogen
/datum/reagent/drug/mushroomhallucinogen.description: A strong hallucinogenic drug derived from certain species of mushroom.

/datum/reagent/drug/blastoff.name: bLaStOoF
/datum/reagent/drug/blastoff.description: A drug for the hardcore party crowd said to enhance ones abilities on the dance floor.\nMost old heads refuse to touch this stuff, perhaps because memories of the luna discoteque incident are seared into their brains.

/datum/reagent/drug/saturnx.name: Saturn-X
/datum/reagent/drug/saturnx.description: This compound was first discovered during the infancy of cloaking technology and at the time thought to be a promising candidate agent. It was withdrawn for consideration after the researchers discovered a slew of associated safety issues including thought disorders and hepatoxicity.

/datum/reagent/drug/saturnx/stable.name: Stabilized Saturn-X
/datum/reagent/drug/saturnx/stable.description: A chemical extract originating from the Saturn-X compound, stabilized and safer for tactical use. After the recipe was discovered, it was planned to be put into mass production, but the program fell apart after its lead disappeared and was never seen again.

/datum/reagent/drug/kronkaine.name: Kronkaine
/datum/reagent/drug/kronkaine.description: A highly illegal stimulant from the edge of the galaxy.\nIt is said the average kronkaine addict causes as much criminal damage as five stick up men, two rascals and one proferssional cambringo hustler combined.

/datum/reagent/drug/kronkaine/gore.name: Gore
/datum/reagent/drug/kronkaine/gore.description: Dirty Kronkaine. You have to be pretty dumb to take this. Don't. Overdose.

/datum/reagent/consumable/nutriment.name: Nutriment
/datum/reagent/consumable/nutriment.description: All the vitamins, minerals, and carbohydrates the body needs in pure form.

/datum/reagent/consumable/nutriment/vita.name: Vitamin
/datum/reagent/consumable/nutriment/vita.description: All the best vitamins, minerals, and carbohydrates the body needs in pure form.

/datum/reagent/consumable/nutriment/prot.name: Protein
/datum/reagent/consumable/nutriment/prot.description: A natural polyamide made up of amino acids. An essential constituent of mosts known forms of life.

/datum/reagent/consumable/nutriment/orga.name: Organ Tissue
/datum/reagent/consumable/nutriment/orga.description: Natural tissues that make up the bulk of organs, providing many vitamins and minerals.

/datum/reagent/consumable/nutriment/clot.name: Cloth Fibers
/datum/reagent/consumable/nutriment/clot.description: It's not actually a form of nutriment but it does keep Mothpeople going for a short while...

/datum/reagent/consumable/cooking_oil.name: Cooking Oil
/datum/reagent/consumable/cooking_oil.description: A variety of cooking oil derived from fat or plants. Used in food preparation and frying.

/datum/reagent/consumable/sugar.name: Sugar
/datum/reagent/consumable/sugar.description: The organic compound commonly known as table sugar and sometimes called saccharose. This white, odorless, crystalline powder has a pleasing, sweet taste.

/datum/reagent/consumable/virus_food.name: Virus Food
/datum/reagent/consumable/virus_food.description: A mixture of water and milk. Virus cells can use this mixture to reproduce.

/datum/reagent/consumable/soysauce.name: Soysauce
/datum/reagent/consumable/soysauce.description: A salty sauce made from the soy plant.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ketchup.name: Ketchup
/datum/reagent/consumable/ketchup.description: Ketchup, catsup, whatever. It's tomato paste.

/datum/reagent/consumable/capsaicin.name: Capsaicin Oil
/datum/reagent/consumable/capsaicin.description: This is what makes chilis hot.

/datum/reagent/consumable/frostoil.name: Frost Oil
/datum/reagent/consumable/frostoil.description: A special oil that noticeably chills the body. Extracted from chilly peppers and slimes.

/datum/reagent/consumable/condensedcapsa.name: Condensed Capsaicin
/datum/reagent/consumable/condensedcapsa.description: A chemical agent used for self-defense and in police work.

/datum/reagent/consumable/salt.name: Table Salt
/datum/reagent/consumable/salt.description: A salt made of sodium chloride. Commonly used to season food.

/datum/reagent/consumable/coco.name: Coco Powder
/datum/reagent/consumable/coco.description: A fatty, bitter paste made from coco beans.

/datum/reagent/consumable/garlic.name: Garlic Juice
/datum/reagent/consumable/garlic.description: Crushed garlic. Chefs love it, but it can make you smell bad.

/datum/reagent/consumable/tearjuice.name: Tear Juice
/datum/reagent/consumable/tearjuice.description: A blinding substance extracted from certain onions.

/datum/reagent/consumable/sprinkles.name: Sprinkles
/datum/reagent/consumable/sprinkles.description: Multi-colored little bits of sugar, commonly found on donuts. Loved by cops.

/datum/reagent/consumable/cornoil.name: Corn Oil
/datum/reagent/consumable/cornoil.description: An oil derived from various types of corn.

/datum/reagent/consumable/enzyme.name: Universal Enzyme
/datum/reagent/consumable/enzyme.description: A universal enzyme used in the preparation of certain chemicals and foods.

/datum/reagent/consumable/dry_ramen.name: Dry Ramen
/datum/reagent/consumable/dry_ramen.description: Space age food, since August 25, 1958. Contains dried noodles, vegetables, and chemicals that boil in contact with water.

/datum/reagent/consumable/hot_ramen.name: Hot Ramen
/datum/reagent/consumable/hot_ramen.description: The noodles are boiled, the flavors are artificial, just like being back in school.

/datum/reagent/consumable/nutraslop.name: Nutraslop
/datum/reagent/consumable/nutraslop.description: Mixture of leftover prison foods served on previous days.

/datum/reagent/consumable/hell_ramen.name: Hell Ramen
/datum/reagent/consumable/hell_ramen.description: The noodles are boiled, the flavors are artificial, just like being back in school.

/datum/reagent/consumable/flour.name: Flour
/datum/reagent/consumable/flour.description: This is what you rub all over yourself to pretend to be a ghost.

/datum/reagent/consumable/cherryjelly.name: Cherry Jelly
/datum/reagent/consumable/cherryjelly.description: Totally the best. Only to be spread on foods with excellent lateral symmetry.

/datum/reagent/consumable/bluecherryjell.name: Blue Cherry Jelly
/datum/reagent/consumable/bluecherryjell.description: Blue and tastier kind of cherry jelly.

/datum/reagent/consumable/vanilla.name: Vanilla Powder
/datum/reagent/consumable/vanilla.description: A fatty, bitter paste made from vanilla pods.

/datum/reagent/consumable/eggwhite.name: Egg White
/datum/reagent/consumable/eggwhite.description: It's full of even more protein.

/datum/reagent/consumable/honey.name: Honey
/datum/reagent/consumable/honey.description: Sweet sweet honey that decays into sugar. Has antibacterial and natural healing properties.

/datum/reagent/consumable/mayonnaise.name: Mayonnaise
/datum/reagent/consumable/mayonnaise.description: A white and oily mixture of mixed egg yolks.

/datum/reagent/consumable/mold.name: Mold
/datum/reagent/consumable/mold.description: This condiment will make any food break the mold. Or your stomach.

/datum/reagent/consumable/nutriment/stab.name: Stabilized Nutriment
/datum/reagent/consumable/nutriment/stab.description: A bioengineered protien-nutrient structure designed to decompose in high saturation. In layman's terms, it won't get you fat.

/datum/reagent/consumable/entpoly.name: Entropic Polypnium
/datum/reagent/consumable/entpoly.description: An ichor, derived from a certain mushroom, makes for a bad time.

/datum/reagent/consumable/tinlux.name: Tinea Luxor
/datum/reagent/consumable/tinlux.description: A stimulating ichor which causes luminescent fungi to grow on the skin.

/datum/reagent/consumable/vitfro.name: Vitrium Froth
/datum/reagent/consumable/vitfro.description: A bubbly paste that heals wounds of the skin.

/datum/reagent/consumable/liquidelectric.name: Liquid Electricity
/datum/reagent/consumable/liquidelectric.description: The blood of Ethereals, and the stuff that keeps them going. Great for them, horrid for anyone else.

/datum/reagent/consumable/nutriment/pept.name: Peptides
/datum/reagent/consumable/nutriment/pept.description: These restorative peptides not only speed up wound healing, but are nutritious as well!

/datum/reagent/consumable/caramel.name: Caramel
/datum/reagent/consumable/caramel.description: Who would have guessed that heated sugar could be so delicious?

/datum/reagent/consumable/char.name: Char
/datum/reagent/consumable/char.description: Essence of the grill. Has strange properties when overdosed.

/datum/reagent/consumable/bbqsauce.name: BBQ Sauce
/datum/reagent/consumable/bbqsauce.description: Sweet, smoky, savory, and gets everywhere. Perfect for grilling.

/datum/reagent/consumable/chocolatepuddi.name: Chocolate Pudding
/datum/reagent/consumable/chocolatepuddi.description: A great dessert for chocolate lovers.

/datum/reagent/consumable/vanillapudding.name: Vanilla Pudding
/datum/reagent/consumable/vanillapudding.description: A great dessert for vanilla lovers.

/datum/reagent/consumable/cherrypudding.name: Cherry Pudding
/datum/reagent/consumable/cherrypudding.description: Cherry pudding in a clear cup with icing and a cherry on top.

/datum/reagent/consumable/laughsyrup.name: Laughin' Syrup
/datum/reagent/consumable/laughsyrup.description: The product of juicing Laughin' Peas. Fizzy, and seems to change flavour based on what it's used with!

/datum/reagent/consumable/gravy.name: Gravy
/datum/reagent/consumable/gravy.description: A mixture of flour, water, and the juices of cooked meat.

/datum/reagent/consumable/pancakebatter.name: Pancake Batter
/datum/reagent/consumable/pancakebatter.description: A very milky batter. 5 units of this on the griddle makes a mean pancake.

/datum/reagent/consumable/korta_flour.name: Korta Flour
/datum/reagent/consumable/korta_flour.description: A coarsely ground, peppery flour made from korta nut shells.

/datum/reagent/consumable/korta_milk.name: Korta Milk
/datum/reagent/consumable/korta_milk.description: A milky liquid made by crushing the centre of a korta nut.

/datum/reagent/consumable/korta_nectar.name: Korta Nectar
/datum/reagent/consumable/korta_nectar.description: A sweet, sugary syrup made from crushed sweet korta nuts.

/datum/reagent/consumable/whipped_cream.name: Whipped Cream
/datum/reagent/consumable/whipped_cream.description: A white fluffy cream made from whipping cream at intense speed.

/datum/reagent/consumable/peanut_butter.name: Peanut Butter
/datum/reagent/consumable/peanut_butter.description: A rich, creamy spread produced by grinding peanuts.

/datum/reagent/consumable/vinegar.name: Vinegar
/datum/reagent/consumable/vinegar.description: Useful for pickling, or putting on chips.

/datum/reagent/consumable/quality_oil.name: Quality Oil
/datum/reagent/consumable/quality_oil.description: A high quality oil, suitable for dishes where the oil is a key flavour.

/datum/reagent/consumable/cornmeal.name: Cornmeal
/datum/reagent/consumable/cornmeal.description: Ground cornmeal, for making corn related things.

/datum/reagent/consumable/yoghurt.name: Yoghurt
/datum/reagent/consumable/yoghurt.description: Creamy natural yoghurt, with applications in both food and drinks.

/datum/reagent/consumable/cornmeal_batte.name: Cornmeal Batter
/datum/reagent/consumable/cornmeal_batte.description: An eggy, milky, corny mixture that's not very good raw.

/datum/reagent/consumable/olivepaste.name: Olive Paste
/datum/reagent/consumable/olivepaste.description: A mushy pile of finely ground olives.

/datum/reagent/consumable/creamer.name: Coffee Creamer
/datum/reagent/consumable/creamer.description: Powdered milk for cheap coffee. How delightful.

/datum/reagent/consumable/mintextract.name: Mint Extract
/datum/reagent/consumable/mintextract.description: Useful for dealing with undesirable customers.

/datum/reagent/consumable/red_bay.name: Red Bay Seasoning
/datum/reagent/consumable/red_bay.description: A secret blend of herbs and spices that goes well with anything- according to Martians, at least.

/datum/reagent/consumable/curry_powder.name: Curry Powder
/datum/reagent/consumable/curry_powder.description: One of humanity's most common spices. Typically used to make curry.

/datum/reagent/consumable/dashi_concentr.name: Dashi Concentrate
/datum/reagent/consumable/dashi_concentr.description: A concentrated form of dashi. Simmer with water in a 1:8 ratio to produce a tasty dashi broth.

/datum/reagent/consumable/martian_batter.name: Martian Batter
/datum/reagent/consumable/martian_batter.description: A thick batter made with dashi and flour, used for making dishes such as okonomiyaki and takoyaki.

/datum/reagent/consumable/grounding_solu.name: Grounding Solution
/datum/reagent/consumable/grounding_solu.description: A food-safe ionic solution designed to neutralise the enigmatic "liquid electricity" that is common to food from Sprout, forming harmless salt on contact.

/datum/reagent/impurity.name: Chemical Isomers
/datum/reagent/impurity.description: Impure chemical isomers made from inoptimal reactions. Causes mild liver damage

/datum/reagent/inverse.name: Toxic Monomers
/datum/reagent/inverse.description: Inverse reagents are created when a reagent's purity is below it's inverse threshold. The are created either during ingestion - which will then replace their associated reagent, or some can be created during the reaction process.

/datum/reagent/consumable/failed_reactio.name: Viscous Sludge
/datum/reagent/consumable/failed_reactio.description: A off smelling sludge that's created when a reaction gets too impure.

/datum/reagent/impurity/eigenswap.name: Eigenswap
/datum/reagent/impurity/eigenswap.description: This reagent is known to swap the handedness of a patient.

/datum/reagent/inverse/cryostylane.name: Cryogelidia
/datum/reagent/inverse/cryostylane.description: Freezes the live or dead patient in a cryostasis ice block.

/datum/reagent/medicine/leporazine.name: Leporazine
/datum/reagent/medicine/leporazine.description: Leporazine will effectively regulate a patient's body temperature, ensuring it never leaves safe levels.

/datum/reagent/medicine/adminordrazine.name: Adminordrazine
/datum/reagent/medicine/adminordrazine.description: It's magic. We don't have to explain it.

/datum/reagent/medicine/adminordrazine/q.name: Quantum Medicine
/datum/reagent/medicine/adminordrazine/q.description: Rare and experimental particles, that apparently swap the user's body with one from an alternate dimension where it's completely healthy.

/datum/reagent/medicine/synaptizine.name: Synaptizine
/datum/reagent/medicine/synaptizine.description: Increases resistance to stuns as well as reducing drowsiness and hallucinations.

/datum/reagent/medicine/synaphydramine.name: Diphen-Synaptizine
/datum/reagent/medicine/synaphydramine.description: Reduces drowsiness, hallucinations, and Histamine from body.

/datum/reagent/medicine/cryoxadone.name: Cryoxadone
/datum/reagent/medicine/cryoxadone.description: A chemical mixture with almost magical healing powers. Its main limitation is that the patient's body temperature must be under 270K for it to metabolise correctly.

/datum/reagent/medicine/clonexadone.name: Clonexadone
/datum/reagent/medicine/clonexadone.description: A chemical that derives from Cryoxadone. It specializes in healing clone damage, but nothing else. Requires very cold temperatures to properly metabolize, and metabolizes quicker than cryoxadone.

/datum/reagent/medicine/pyroxadone.name: Pyroxadone
/datum/reagent/medicine/pyroxadone.description: A mixture of cryoxadone and slime jelly, that apparently inverses the requirement for its activation.

/datum/reagent/medicine/rezadone.name: Rezadone
/datum/reagent/medicine/rezadone.description: A powder derived from fish toxin, Rezadone can effectively treat genetic damage as well as restoring minor wounds and restoring corpses husked by burns. Overdose will cause intense nausea and minor toxin damage.

/datum/reagent/medicine/oxandrolone.name: Oxandrolone
/datum/reagent/medicine/oxandrolone.description: stimulates the healing of severe burns. Extremely rapidly heals severe burns and slowly heals minor ones. Overdose will worsen existing burns.

/datum/reagent/medicine/salglu_solution.name: Saline-Glucose Solution
/datum/reagent/medicine/salglu_solution.description: Has a 33% chance per metabolism cycle to heal brute and burn damage. Can be used as a temporary blood substitute, as well as slowly speeding blood regeneration.

/datum/reagent/medicine/mine_salve.name: Miner's Salve
/datum/reagent/medicine/mine_salve.description: A powerful painkiller. Restores bruising and burns in addition to making the patient believe they are fully healed. Also great for treating severe burn wounds in a pinch.

/datum/reagent/medicine/omnizine.name: Omnizine
/datum/reagent/medicine/omnizine.description: Slowly heals all damage types. Overdose will cause damage in all types instead.

/datum/reagent/medicine/omnizine/protozi.name: Protozine
/datum/reagent/medicine/omnizine/protozi.description: A less environmentally friendly and somewhat weaker variant of omnizine.

/datum/reagent/medicine/calomel.name: Calomel
/datum/reagent/medicine/calomel.description: Quickly purges the body of all chemicals except itself. The more health a person has,  the more toxin damage it will deal. It can heal toxin damage when people have low enough health.

/datum/reagent/medicine/ammoniated_mercu.name: Ammoniated Mercury
/datum/reagent/medicine/ammoniated_mercu.description: Quickly purges the body of toxic chemicals. Heals toxin damage when in a good condition someone has  		no brute and fire damage. When hurt with brute or fire damage, it can deal a great amount of toxin damage.  When there are no toxins present, it starts slowly purging itself.

/datum/reagent/medicine/potass_iodide.name: Potassium Iodide
/datum/reagent/medicine/potass_iodide.description: Heals low toxin damage while the patient is irradiated, and will halt the damaging effects of radiation. Can be used to decontaminate irradiated items.

/datum/reagent/medicine/pen_acid.name: Pentetic Acid
/datum/reagent/medicine/pen_acid.description: Reduces massive amounts of toxin damage while purging other chemicals from the body.

/datum/reagent/medicine/sal_acid.name: Salicylic Acid
/datum/reagent/medicine/sal_acid.description: stimulates the healing of severe bruises. Extremely rapidly heals severe bruising and slowly heals minor ones. Overdose will worsen existing bruising.

/datum/reagent/medicine/salbutamol.name: Salbutamol
/datum/reagent/medicine/salbutamol.description: Rapidly restores oxygen deprivation as well as preventing more of it to an extent.

/datum/reagent/medicine/ephedrine.name: Ephedrine
/datum/reagent/medicine/ephedrine.description: Increases resistance to batons and movement speed, giving you hand cramps. Overdose deals toxin damage and inhibits breathing.

/datum/reagent/medicine/diphenhydramine.name: Diphenhydramine
/datum/reagent/medicine/diphenhydramine.description: Rapidly purges the body of Histamine and reduces jitteriness. Slight chance of causing drowsiness.

/datum/reagent/medicine/painkiller/morph.name: Morphine
/datum/reagent/medicine/painkiller/morph.description: A painkiller that allows the patient to move at full speed even when injured. Causes drowsiness and eventually unconsciousness in high doses. Overdose will cause a variety of effects, ranging from minor to lethal.

/datum/reagent/medicine/oculine.name: Oculine
/datum/reagent/medicine/oculine.description: Quickly restores eye damage, cures nearsightedness, and has a chance to restore vision to the blind.

/datum/reagent/medicine/inacusiate.name: Inacusiate
/datum/reagent/medicine/inacusiate.description: Rapidly repairs damage to the patient's ears to cure deafness, assuming the source of said deafness isn't from genetic mutations, chronic deafness, or a total defecit of ears.

/datum/reagent/medicine/atropine.name: Atropine
/datum/reagent/medicine/atropine.description: If a patient is in critical condition, rapidly heals all damage types as well as regulating oxygen in the body. Excellent for stabilizing wounded patients, and said to neutralize blood-activated internal explosives found amongst clandestine black op agents.

/datum/reagent/medicine/epinephrine.name: Epinephrine
/datum/reagent/medicine/epinephrine.description: Very minor boost to stun resistance. Slowly heals damage if a patient is in critical condition, as well as regulating oxygen loss. Overdose causes weakness and toxin damage.

/datum/reagent/medicine/strange_reagent.name: Strange Reagent
/datum/reagent/medicine/strange_reagent.description: A miracle drug capable of bringing the dead back to life. Works topically unless anotamically complex, in which case works orally. Cannot revive targets under -%MAXHEALTHRATIO% health.

/datum/reagent/medicine/strange_reagent/.name: Stranger Reagent
/datum/reagent/medicine/strange_reagent/.description: A miracle drug capable of bringing the dead back to life. Works topically unless anotamically complex, in which case works orally. Cannot revive targets under -%MAXHEALTHRATIO% health.

/datum/reagent/medicine/neurine.name: Neurine
/datum/reagent/medicine/neurine.description: Reacts with neural tissue, helping reform damaged connections. Can cure minor traumas.

/datum/reagent/medicine/mutadone.name: Mutadone
/datum/reagent/medicine/mutadone.description: Removes jitteriness and restores genetic defects.

/datum/reagent/medicine/antihol.name: Antihol
/datum/reagent/medicine/antihol.description: Purges alcoholic substance from the patient's body and eliminates its side effects.

/datum/reagent/medicine/stimulants.name: Stimulants
/datum/reagent/medicine/stimulants.description: Increases resistance to batons and movement speed in addition to restoring minor damage and weakness. Overdose causes weakness and toxin damage.

/datum/reagent/medicine/inaprovaline.name: Inaprovaline
/datum/reagent/medicine/inaprovaline.description: Stabilizes the breathing of patients. Good for those in critical condition.

/datum/reagent/medicine/regen_jelly.name: Regenerative Jelly
/datum/reagent/medicine/regen_jelly.description: Gradually regenerates all types of damage, without harming slime anatomy.

/datum/reagent/medicine/regen_jelly/weak.name: Weakened Regenerative Jelly
/datum/reagent/medicine/regen_jelly/weak.description: Artificially weakened regenerative slime jelly that regenerates tissues slower, but lasts longer with the same volume.

/datum/reagent/medicine/syndicate_nanite.name: Restorative Nanites
/datum/reagent/medicine/syndicate_nanite.description: Miniature medical robots that swiftly restore bodily damage.

/datum/reagent/medicine/earthsblood.name: Earthsblood
/datum/reagent/medicine/earthsblood.description: Ichor from an extremely powerful plant. Great for restoring wounds, but it's a little heavy on the brain. For some strange reason, it also induces temporary pacifism in those who imbibe it and semi-permanent pacifism in those who overdose on it.

/datum/reagent/medicine/haloperidol.name: Haloperidol
/datum/reagent/medicine/haloperidol.description: Increases depletion rates for most stimulating/hallucinogenic drugs. Reduces druggy effects and jitteriness. Severe stamina regeneration penalty, causes drowsiness. Small chance of brain damage.

/datum/reagent/medicine/changelinghaste.name: Changeling Haste
/datum/reagent/medicine/changelinghaste.description: Drastically increases movement speed, but deals toxin damage.

/datum/reagent/medicine/higadrite.name: Higadrite
/datum/reagent/medicine/higadrite.description: A medication utilized to treat ailing livers.

/datum/reagent/medicine/cordiolis_hepati.name: Cordiolis Hepatico
/datum/reagent/medicine/cordiolis_hepati.description: A strange, pitch-black reagent that seems to absorb all light. Effects unknown.

/datum/reagent/medicine/muscle_stimulant.name: Muscle Stimulant
/datum/reagent/medicine/muscle_stimulant.description: A potent chemical that allows someone under its influence to be at full physical ability even when under massive amounts of pain.

/datum/reagent/medicine/modafinil.name: Modafinil
/datum/reagent/medicine/modafinil.description: Long-lasting sleep suppressant that very slightly reduces stun and knockdown times. Overdosing has horrendous side effects and deals lethal oxygen damage, will knock you unconscious if not dealt with.

/datum/reagent/medicine/psicodine.name: Psicodine
/datum/reagent/medicine/psicodine.description: Suppresses anxiety and other various forms of mental distress. Overdose causes hallucinations and minor toxin damage.

/datum/reagent/medicine/metafactor.name: Mitogen Metabolism Factor
/datum/reagent/medicine/metafactor.description: This enzyme catalyzes the conversion of nutricious food into healing peptides.

/datum/reagent/medicine/silibinin.name: Silibinin
/datum/reagent/medicine/silibinin.description: A thistle derrived hepatoprotective flavolignan mixture that help reverse damage to the liver.

/datum/reagent/medicine/polypyr.name: Polypyrylium Oligomers
/datum/reagent/medicine/polypyr.description: A purple mixture of short polyelectrolyte chains not easily synthesized in the laboratory. It is valued as an intermediate in the synthesis of the cutting edge pharmaceuticals.

/datum/reagent/medicine/granibitaluri.name: Granibitaluri
/datum/reagent/medicine/granibitaluri.description: A mild painkiller useful as an additive alongside more potent medicines. Speeds up the healing of small wounds and burns, but is ineffective at treating severe injuries. Extremely large doses are toxic, and may eventually cause liver failure.

/datum/reagent/medicine/coagulant.name: Sanguirite
/datum/reagent/medicine/coagulant.description: A proprietary coagulant used to help bleeding wounds clot faster. It is purged by heparin.

/datum/reagent/medicine/coagulant/banana.name: Pulped Banana Peel
/datum/reagent/medicine/coagulant/banana.description: Ancient Clown Lore says that pulped banana peels are good for your blood, but are you really going to take medical advice from a clown about bananas?

/datum/reagent/medicine/coagulant/seraka.name: Seraka Extract
/datum/reagent/medicine/coagulant/seraka.description: A deeply coloured oil present in small amounts in Seraka Mushrooms. Acts as an effective blood clotting agent, but has a low overdose threshold.

/datum/reagent/medicine/painkiller/robop.name: Positronic Neural Dampener
/datum/reagent/medicine/painkiller/robop.description: Reduces the stimulus response capacity of positronic systems, anesthetizing, soothing, and in high doses, rendering them unconcious.

/datum/reagent/medicine/naloxone.name: Naloxone
/datum/reagent/medicine/naloxone.description: Opioid antagonist that purges drowsiness and narcotics from the patient, restores breath loss and accelerates addiction recovery.

/datum/reagent/blood.name: Blood
/datum/reagent/blood.description: Blood cells suspended in plasma, the most abundant of which being the hemoglobin-containing red blood cells.

/datum/reagent/consumable/liquidgibs.name: Liquid gibs
/datum/reagent/consumable/liquidgibs.description: You don't even want to think about what's in here.

/datum/reagent/water.name: Water
/datum/reagent/water.description: An ubiquitous chemical substance that is composed of hydrogen and oxygen.

/datum/reagent/water/salt.name: Saltwater
/datum/reagent/water/salt.description: Water, but salty. Smells like... the station infirmary?

/datum/reagent/water/hollowwater.name: Hollow Water
/datum/reagent/water/hollowwater.description: An ubiquitous chemical substance that is composed of hydrogen and oxygen, but it looks kinda hollow.

/datum/reagent/hydrogen_peroxide.name: Hydrogen Peroxide
/datum/reagent/hydrogen_peroxide.description: An ubiquitous chemical substance that is composed of hydrogen and oxygen and oxygen.

/datum/reagent/fuel/unholywater.name: Unholy Water
/datum/reagent/fuel/unholywater.description: Something that shouldn't exist on this plane of existence.

/datum/reagent/medicine/omnizine/godbloo.name: Godblood
/datum/reagent/medicine/omnizine/godbloo.description: Slowly heals all damage types. Has a rather high overdose threshold. Glows with mysterious power.

/datum/reagent/lube.name: Space Lube
/datum/reagent/lube.description: Lubricant is a substance introduced between two moving surfaces to reduce the friction and wear between them. giggity.

/datum/reagent/lube/superlube.name: Super Duper Lube
/datum/reagent/lube/superlube.description: This \[REDACTED\] has been outlawed after the incident on \[DATA EXPUNGED\].

/datum/reagent/spraytan.name: Spray Tan
/datum/reagent/spraytan.description: A substance applied to the skin to darken the skin.

/datum/reagent/mulligan.name: Mulligan Toxin
/datum/reagent/mulligan.description: This toxin will rapidly change the DNA of humanoid beings. Commonly used by Syndicate spies and assassins in need of an emergency ID change.

/datum/reagent/aslimetoxin.name: Advanced Mutation Toxin
/datum/reagent/aslimetoxin.description: An advanced corruptive toxin produced by slimes.

/datum/reagent/gluttonytoxin.name: Gluttony's Blessing
/datum/reagent/gluttonytoxin.description: An advanced corruptive toxin produced by something terrible.

/datum/reagent/serotrotium.name: Serotrotium
/datum/reagent/serotrotium.description: A chemical compound that promotes concentrated production of the serotonin neurotransmitter in humans.

/datum/reagent/oxygen.name: Oxygen
/datum/reagent/oxygen.description: A colorless, odorless gas. Grows on trees but is still pretty valuable.

/datum/reagent/copper.name: Copper
/datum/reagent/copper.description: A highly ductile metal. Things made out of copper aren't very durable, but it makes a decent material for electrical wiring.

/datum/reagent/nitrogen.name: Nitrogen
/datum/reagent/nitrogen.description: A colorless, odorless, tasteless gas. A simple asphyxiant that can silently displace vital oxygen.

/datum/reagent/hydrogen.name: Hydrogen
/datum/reagent/hydrogen.description: A colorless, odorless, nonmetallic, tasteless, highly combustible diatomic gas.

/datum/reagent/potassium.name: Potassium
/datum/reagent/potassium.description: A soft, low-melting solid that can easily be cut with a knife. Reacts violently with water.

/datum/reagent/mercury.name: Mercury
/datum/reagent/mercury.description: A curious metal that's a liquid at room temperature. Neurodegenerative and very bad for the mind.

/datum/reagent/sulfur.name: Sulfur
/datum/reagent/sulfur.description: A sickly yellow solid mostly known for its nasty smell. It's actually much more helpful than it looks in biochemisty.

/datum/reagent/carbon.name: Carbon
/datum/reagent/carbon.description: A crumbly black solid that, while unexciting on a physical level, forms the base of all known life. Kind of a big deal.

/datum/reagent/chlorine.name: Chlorine
/datum/reagent/chlorine.description: A pale yellow gas that's well known as an oxidizer. While it forms many harmless molecules in its elemental form it is far from harmless.

/datum/reagent/fluorine.name: Fluorine
/datum/reagent/fluorine.description: A comically-reactive chemical element. The universe does not want this stuff to exist in this form in the slightest.

/datum/reagent/sodium.name: Sodium
/datum/reagent/sodium.description: A soft silver metal that can easily be cut with a knife. It's not salt just yet, so refrain from putting it on your chips.

/datum/reagent/phosphorus.name: Phosphorus
/datum/reagent/phosphorus.description: A ruddy red powder that burns readily. Though it comes in many colors, the general theme is always the same.

/datum/reagent/lithium.name: Lithium
/datum/reagent/lithium.description: A silver metal, its claim to fame is its remarkably low density. Using it is a bit too effective in calming oneself down.

/datum/reagent/glycerol.name: Glycerol
/datum/reagent/glycerol.description: Glycerol is a simple polyol compound. Glycerol is sweet-tasting and of low toxicity.

/datum/reagent/space_cleaner/sterilizine.name: Sterilizine
/datum/reagent/space_cleaner/sterilizine.description: Sterilizes wounds in preparation for surgery.

/datum/reagent/gold.name: Gold
/datum/reagent/gold.description: Gold is a dense, soft, shiny metal and the most malleable and ductile metal known.

/datum/reagent/silver.name: Silver
/datum/reagent/silver.description: A soft, white, lustrous transition metal, it has the highest electrical conductivity of any element and the highest thermal conductivity of any metal.

/datum/reagent/uranium.name: Uranium
/datum/reagent/uranium.description: A jade-green metallic chemical element in the actinide series, weakly radioactive.

/datum/reagent/uranium/radium.name: Radium
/datum/reagent/uranium/radium.description: Radium is an alkaline earth metal. It is extremely radioactive.

/datum/reagent/bluespace.name: Bluespace Dust
/datum/reagent/bluespace.description: A dust composed of microscopic bluespace crystals, with minor space-warping properties.

/datum/reagent/aluminium.name: Aluminium
/datum/reagent/aluminium.description: A silvery white and ductile member of the boron group of chemical elements.

/datum/reagent/silicon.name: Silicon
/datum/reagent/silicon.description: A tetravalent metalloid, silicon is less reactive than its chemical analog carbon.

/datum/reagent/space_cleaner.name: Space Cleaner
/datum/reagent/space_cleaner.description: A compound used to clean things. Now with 50% more sodium hypochlorite! Can be used to clean wounds, but it's not really meant for that.

/datum/reagent/space_cleaner/ez_clean.name: EZ Clean
/datum/reagent/space_cleaner/ez_clean.description: A powerful, acidic cleaner sold by Waffle Co. Affects organic matter while leaving other objects unaffected.

/datum/reagent/impedrezene.name: Impedrezene
/datum/reagent/impedrezene.description: Impedrezene is a narcotic that impedes one's ability by slowing down the higher brain cell functions.

/datum/reagent/xenomicrobes.name: Xenomicrobes
/datum/reagent/xenomicrobes.description: Microbes with an entirely alien cellular structure.

/datum/reagent/snail.name: Agent-S
/datum/reagent/snail.description: Virological agent that infects the subject with Gastrolosis.

/datum/reagent/fluorosurfactant.name: Fluorosurfactant
/datum/reagent/fluorosurfactant.description: A perfluoronated sulfonic acid that forms a foam when mixed with water.

/datum/reagent/foaming_agent.name: Foaming Agent
/datum/reagent/foaming_agent.description: An agent that yields metallic foam when mixed with light metal and a strong acid.

/datum/reagent/smart_foaming_agent.name: Smart Foaming Agent
/datum/reagent/smart_foaming_agent.description: An agent that yields metallic foam which conforms to area boundaries when mixed with light metal and a strong acid.

/datum/reagent/ammonia.name: Ammonia
/datum/reagent/ammonia.description: A caustic substance commonly used in fertilizer or household cleaners.

/datum/reagent/carbondioxide.name: Carbon Dioxide
/datum/reagent/carbondioxide.description: A gas commonly produced by burning carbon fuels. You're constantly producing this in your lungs.

/datum/reagent/nitrous_oxide.name: Nitrous Oxide
/datum/reagent/nitrous_oxide.description: A potent oxidizer used as fuel in rockets and as an anaesthetic during surgery. As it is an anticoagulant, nitrous oxide is best  used alongside sanguirite to allow blood clotting to continue.

/datum/reagent/colorful_reagent/powder.name: Mundane Powder
/datum/reagent/colorful_reagent/powder.description: A powder that is used for coloring things.

/datum/reagent/plantnutriment.name: Generic Nutriment
/datum/reagent/plantnutriment.description: Some kind of nutriment. You can't really tell what it is. You should probably report it, along with how you obtained it.

/datum/reagent/plantnutriment/eznutrimen.name: E-Z Nutrient
/datum/reagent/plantnutriment/eznutrimen.description: Contains electrolytes. It's what plants crave. It makes plants slowly gain potency and yield

/datum/reagent/plantnutriment/left4zednu.name: Left 4 Zed
/datum/reagent/plantnutriment/left4zednu.description: Unstable nutriment that makes plants wilt quickly but increases all stats while doing so.

/datum/reagent/plantnutriment/robustharv.name: Robust Harvest
/datum/reagent/plantnutriment/robustharv.description: Very potent nutriment that slows plants from mutating whilst also making them grow faster.

/datum/reagent/plantnutriment/endurogrow.name: Enduro Grow
/datum/reagent/plantnutriment/endurogrow.description: A specialized nutriment, which decreases product quantity and potency, but strengthens the plants endurance.

/datum/reagent/plantnutriment/liquideart.name: Liquid Earthquake
/datum/reagent/plantnutriment/liquideart.description: A specialized nutriment, which increases the plant's production speed, as well as it's susceptibility to weeds.

/datum/reagent/fuel/oil.name: Oil
/datum/reagent/fuel/oil.description: Burns in a small smoky fire, can be used to get Ash.

/datum/reagent/stable_plasma.name: Stable Plasma
/datum/reagent/stable_plasma.description: Non-flammable plasma locked into a liquid form that cannot ignite or become gaseous/solid.

/datum/reagent/iodine.name: Iodine
/datum/reagent/iodine.description: Commonly added to table salt as a nutrient. On its own it tastes far less pleasing.

/datum/reagent/carpet.name: Carpet
/datum/reagent/carpet.description: For those that need a more creative way to roll out a red carpet.

/datum/reagent/carpet/black.name: Black Carpet
/datum/reagent/carpet/black.description: The carpet also comes in... BLAPCK

/datum/reagent/carpet/blue.name: Blue Carpet
/datum/reagent/carpet/blue.description: For those that really need to chill out for a while.

/datum/reagent/carpet/cyan.name: Cyan Carpet
/datum/reagent/carpet/cyan.description: For those that need a throwback to the years of using poison as a construction material. Smells like asbestos.

/datum/reagent/carpet/green.name: Green Carpet
/datum/reagent/carpet/green.description: For those that need the perfect flourish for green eggs and ham.

/datum/reagent/carpet/orange.name: Orange Carpet

/datum/reagent/carpet/neon/simple_teal.description: For those who need a smoke.

/datum/reagent/carpet/neon/simple_cyan.name: Simple Cyan Neon Carpet

/datum/reagent/carpet/neon/simple_purple.name: Simple Purple Neon Carpet
/datum/reagent/carpet/neon/simple_purple.description: For those that need a little bit of exploration.

/datum/reagent/carpet/neon/simple_violet.name: Simple Violet Neon Carpet

/datum/reagent/carpet/neon/simple_pink.name: Simple Pink Neon Carpet
/datum/reagent/carpet/neon/simple_pink.description: For those just want to stop thinking so much.

/datum/reagent/carpet/neon/simple_black.name: Simple Black Neon Carpet
/datum/reagent/carpet/neon/simple_black.description: For those who need to catch their breath.

/datum/reagent/bromine.name: Bromine

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/ersatz.description: Sweet, bitter, spicy- that's a great combination.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/red_ci.name: Red City AM
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/red_ci.description: A breakfast drink from New Osaka, for when you really need to get drunk at 9:30 in the morning in more socially acceptable manner than drinking bagwine on the bullet train. Not that you should drink this on the bullet train either.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/kings_.name: King's Ransom
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/kings_.description: A stiff, bitter drink with an odd name and odder recipe.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/four_b.name: Four Bit
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/four_b.description: A drink to power your typing hands.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/white_.name: White Hawaiian
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/white_.description: A take on the classic White Russian, subbing out the classics for some tropical flavours.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/maui_s.name: Maui Sunrise
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/maui_s.description: Behind this drink's red facade lurks a sharp, complex flavour.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/imperi.name: Imperial Mai Tai
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/imperi.description: For when orgeat is in short supply, do as the spacers do- make do and mend.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/konoco.name: Konococo Rumtini
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/konoco.description: Coconut rum, coffee liqueur, and espresso- an odd combination, to be sure, but a welcomed one.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/boston.name: Boston Sour
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/boston.description: Whiskey sour texturally elevated by an egg white.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/star.name: Star
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/star.description: A blend of applejack and vermouth accented with bitters.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/old_fa.name: Old Fashioned
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/old_fa.description: By some measures the first cocktail, made by flavoring a hard spirit with sugar and bitters, with the spirit in question most often being whiskey in modern times.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/sazera.name: Sazerac
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/sazera.description: Whiskey made aromatic by absinthe and creole bitters.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/amaret.name: Amaretto Sour
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/amaret.description: A sour made with sweet amaretto.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/ramos_.name: Ramos Gin Fizz
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/ramos_.description: A complex twist on the concept of a gin fizz, adding cream and egg white along side lemon juice for an incomparable textural experience. In this version, the drink's signature usage of orange blossom water is replaced with a drop of orange liqueur.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/french.name: French 75
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/french.description: A sophisticated cocktail made by strengthening champagne with gin, then flavoring with lemon juice and sugar.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/sangri.name: Sangria
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/sangri.description: A blood-red wine punch strengthened with liquor and sweetened with as much chopped fruit as one can get their hands on.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/suffer.name: Suffering Bastard
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/suffer.description: A tiki style hangover cure made from ginger beer, spirits, and bitters.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/blue_b.name: Blue Blazer
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/blue_b.description: The signature drink of a legendary bartender from the 19th century. While remembered for how he innovated the art of bartending, at the end of the day this drink is really just warmed and sweetened whiskey.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/hot_to.name: Hot Toddy
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/hot_to.description: A warmed blend of spirits, sugar, and spices. While the concept is ancient, this preparation with cognac and refined sugar is a bit more modern.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/tiziri.name: Tizirian Sour
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/tiziri.description: A twist on a trinidad sour, using korta nectar in place of orgeat. Despite the name, it was invented by a martian barkeep.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/daiqui.name: Daiquiri
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/daiqui.description: In some ways the ultimate tropical cocktail, very few rum drinks are not in some way a descendant of this classic.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/flip_c.name: Flip Cocktail
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/flip_c.description: A simplified and modernized adaptation of a much older drink that predates the Cocktail. While the older version used ale and was heated before it was drunk, this version is chilled. Really, the main similarity is the use of a whole egg.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/aperit.name: Aperitivo Liqueur
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/aperit.description: An aggressively bittersweet liqueur flavored with cinchona bark and other botanicals. Perfect for stimulating one's appetite or fighting off malaria.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/herbal.name: Herbal Liqueur
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/herbal.description: A liqueur made with a wide variety of herbs and spices, infused into spirit through both distillation and maceration. So many, in fact, that trying to pick them out by scent and taste seems nearly impossible...

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/marasc.name: Maraschino Liqueur
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/marasc.description: A classic sweet liqueur made from the fruits, leaves, and even branches of sour cherries. Surprisingly, it doesn't actually taste much like cherry.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/barten.name: Bartender's Handshake
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/barten.description: A tradition of somewhat inconsistent providence, possibly linked to an obscure challenge-coin-based marketing scheme, this drink is a way for bartenders to greet and test each other's mettle via a drink that only a fellow barkeep could appreciate. While there are nearly as many versions of this drink as there are bars, this version tests one's palate by combining two of the most bitter ingredients you're likely to find in a bar.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/brandy.name: Brandy Crusta
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/brandy.description: The far more gussied-up ancestor of the Sidecar, this heavily garnished cocktail is the grandparent of many essential drinks served today.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/casino.name: Casino
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/casino.description: A gin-heavy classic. Juniper is tempered by scant amounts of citrus and sweetened with liqueur.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/gariba.name: Garibaldi
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/gariba.description: Named for the 19th-century Italian general, the red-orange color scheme of this drink mimics the shirts of those who followed him into battles all across the world.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/improv.name: Improved Whiskey Cocktail
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/improv.description: The Classic Whiskey cocktail improved by the addition of absinthe and maraschino, as well as swapping the typical orange peel garnish for lemon.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/jungle.name: Jungle Bird
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/jungle.description: This late-tiki concoction leverages the brilliant combination of bitter liqueur and pineapple juice to make a remarkably well-balanced cocktail.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/last_w.name: Last Word
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/last_w.description: Despite being invented at the turn of the 20th century, this drink fell into obscurity until the cocktail renaissance of the beginning of the 21st, where it then went on to dominate bars and inspire countless twists upon its formula.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/mary_p.name: Mary Pickford
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/mary_p.description: Named after an early 20th-century film star, this cocktail takes a rum and pineapple flavor profile and presents it in a classier and more elegant form than one would typically expect.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/negron.name: Negroni
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/negron.description: An iconic Italian aperitif, its simple intensity crowns it as perhaps the ultimate bitter cocktail. Supposedly it was named after an Italian count who wanted a stronger version of a spritz and asked his bartender to replace soda with gin.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/nuclea.name: Nuclear daiquiri
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/nuclea.description: Overproof, funky, pot still rum and herbal liqueur takes the simple elegance of a Cuban daiquiri and turns it on its head.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/nuclea.name: Thermonuclear Daiquiri
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/nuclea.description: A drink for those who enjoy the gnarlier things in life, like high-ester rums and Cobalt 60.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/poets_.name: Poet's Dream
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/poets_.description: This cocktail takes a classic martini base and twists it into a deliciously sweet and herbal mode. Nanotrasen regulations state not to drink this too soon before sleep, or risk 'oneiric encroachment,' whatever that means.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/pousse.name: Pousse Cafe
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/pousse.description: An aesthetically beautiful cocktail made from the careful and meticulous layering of various liquors. Extremely annoying to make.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/spritz.name: Spritz
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/spritz.description: This bittersweet and refreshing aperitif brings to mind the beautiful summer sunsets of venice.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/vieux_.name: Vieux Carré
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/vieux_.description: One of the best of many great cocktails to come out of New Orleans, this drink does honor to that city's French Quarter both in name and in taste.

/datum/reagent/consumable/orangejuice.name: Orange Juice
/datum/reagent/consumable/orangejuice.description: Both delicious AND rich in Vitamin C, what more do you need?

/datum/reagent/consumable/tomatojuice.name: Tomato Juice
/datum/reagent/consumable/tomatojuice.description: Tomatoes made into juice. What a waste of big, juicy tomatoes, huh?

/datum/reagent/consumable/carrotjuice.name: Carrot Juice
/datum/reagent/consumable/carrotjuice.description: It is just like a carrot but without crunching.

/datum/reagent/consumable/berryjuice.name: Berry Juice
/datum/reagent/consumable/berryjuice.description: A delicious blend of several different kinds of berries.

/datum/reagent/consumable/applejuice.name: Apple Juice
/datum/reagent/consumable/applejuice.description: The sweet juice of an apple, fit for all ages.

/datum/reagent/consumable/poisonberryjui.name: Poison Berry Juice
/datum/reagent/consumable/poisonberryjui.description: A tasty juice blended from various kinds of very deadly and toxic berries.

/datum/reagent/consumable/banana.name: Banana Juice
/datum/reagent/consumable/banana.description: The raw essence of a banana. HONK

/datum/reagent/consumable/laughter.name: Laughter
/datum/reagent/consumable/laughter.description: Some say that this is the best medicine, but recent studies have proven that to be untrue.

/datum/reagent/consumable/superlaughter.name: Super Laughter
/datum/reagent/consumable/superlaughter.description: Funny until you're the one laughing.

/datum/reagent/consumable/grapejuice.name: Grape Juice
/datum/reagent/consumable/grapejuice.description: The juice of a bunch of grapes. Guaranteed non-alcoholic.

/datum/reagent/consumable/milk.name: Milk
/datum/reagent/consumable/milk.description: An opaque white liquid produced by the mammary glands of mammals.

/datum/reagent/consumable/soymilk.name: Soy Milk
/datum/reagent/consumable/soymilk.description: An opaque white liquid made from soybeans.

/datum/reagent/consumable/cream.name: Cream
/datum/reagent/consumable/cream.description: The fatty, still liquid part of milk. Why don't you mix this with sum scotch, eh?

/datum/reagent/consumable/coffee.name: Coffee
/datum/reagent/consumable/coffee.description: Coffee is a brewed drink prepared from roasted seeds, commonly called coffee beans, of the coffee plant.

/datum/reagent/consumable/tea.name: Tea
/datum/reagent/consumable/tea.description: Tasty black tea, it has antioxidants, it's good for you!

/datum/reagent/consumable/lemonade.name: Lemonade
/datum/reagent/consumable/lemonade.description: Sweet, tangy lemonade. Good for the soul.

/datum/reagent/consumable/tea/arnold_pal.name: Arnold Palmer
/datum/reagent/consumable/tea/arnold_pal.description: Encourages the patient to go golfing.

/datum/reagent/consumable/icecoffee.name: Iced Coffee
/datum/reagent/consumable/icecoffee.description: Coffee and ice, refreshing and cool.

/datum/reagent/consumable/icetea.name: Iced Tea
/datum/reagent/consumable/icetea.description: No relation to a certain rap artist/actor.

/datum/reagent/consumable/rootbeer.name: root beer
/datum/reagent/consumable/rootbeer.description: A delightfully bubbly root beer, filled with so much sugar that it can actually speed up the user's trigger finger.

/datum/reagent/consumable/grey_bull.name: Grey Bull
/datum/reagent/consumable/grey_bull.description: Grey Bull, it gives you gloves!

/datum/reagent/consumable/spacemountainw.name: SM Wind
/datum/reagent/consumable/spacemountainw.description: Blows right through you like a space wind.

/datum/reagent/consumable/dr_gibb.name: Dr. Gibb
/datum/reagent/consumable/dr_gibb.description: A delicious blend of 42 different flavours.

/datum/reagent/consumable/space_up.name: Space-Up
/datum/reagent/consumable/space_up.description: Tastes like a hull breach in your mouth.

/datum/reagent/consumable/lemon_lime.name: Lemon Lime
/datum/reagent/consumable/lemon_lime.description: A tangy substance made of 0.5% natural citrus!

/datum/reagent/consumable/pwr_game.name: Pwr Game
/datum/reagent/consumable/pwr_game.description: The only drink with the PWR that true gamers crave.

/datum/reagent/consumable/shamblers.name: Shambler's Juice
/datum/reagent/consumable/shamblers.description: ~Shake me up some of that Shambler's Juice!~

/datum/reagent/consumable/sodawater.name: Soda Water
/datum/reagent/consumable/sodawater.description: A can of club soda. Why not make a scotch and soda?

/datum/reagent/consumable/tonic.name: Tonic Water
/datum/reagent/consumable/tonic.description: It tastes strange but at least the quinine keeps the Space Malaria at bay.

/datum/reagent/consumable/wellcheers.name: Wellcheers
/datum/reagent/consumable/wellcheers.description: A strange purple drink, smelling of saltwater. Somewhere in the distance, you hear seagulls.

/datum/reagent/consumable/monkey_energy.name: Monkey Energy
/datum/reagent/consumable/monkey_energy.description: The only drink that will make you unleash the ape.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ice.name: Ice
/datum/reagent/consumable/ice.description: Frozen water, your dentist wouldn't like you chewing this.

/datum/reagent/consumable/soy_latte.name: Soy Latte
/datum/reagent/consumable/soy_latte.description: A nice and tasty beverage while you are reading your hippie books.

/datum/reagent/consumable/cafe_latte.name: Cafe Latte
/datum/reagent/consumable/cafe_latte.description: A nice, strong and tasty beverage while you are reading.

/datum/reagent/consumable/doctor_delight.name: The Doctor's Delight
/datum/reagent/consumable/doctor_delight.description: A gulp a day keeps the Medibot away! A mixture of juices that heals most damage types fairly quickly at the cost of hunger.

/datum/reagent/consumable/cinderella.name: Cinderella
/datum/reagent/consumable/cinderella.description: Most definitely a fruity alcohol cocktail to have while partying with your friends.

/datum/reagent/consumable/vanillashake.name: Vanilla Shake
/datum/reagent/consumable/vanillashake.description: A vanilla flavored milkshake. The basics are still good.

/datum/reagent/consumable/caramelshake.name: Caramel Shake
/datum/reagent/consumable/caramelshake.description: A caramel flavored milkshake. Your teeth hurt looking at it.

/datum/reagent/consumable/bananashake.name: Banana Shake
/datum/reagent/consumable/bananashake.description: A banana milkshake. Stuff that clowns drink at their honkday parties.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/maltsh.name: Malt Milkshake
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/maltsh.description: A slightly alcoholic but sweet milkshake

/datum/reagent/consumable/pumpkin_latte.name: Pumpkin Latte
/datum/reagent/consumable/pumpkin_latte.description: A mix of pumpkin juice and coffee.

/datum/reagent/consumable/gibbfloats.name: Gibb Floats
/datum/reagent/consumable/gibbfloats.description: Ice cream on top of a Dr. Gibb glass.

/datum/reagent/consumable/bogril.name: Bogril
/datum/reagent/consumable/bogril.description: A savoury meat broth for drinking.

/datum/reagent/consumable/hot_coco.name: Hot Coco
/datum/reagent/consumable/hot_coco.description: Made with love! And coco beans.

/datum/reagent/consumable/italian_coco.name: Italian Hot Chocolate
/datum/reagent/consumable/italian_coco.description: Made with love! You can just imagine a happy Nonna from the smell.

/datum/reagent/consumable/menthol.name: Menthol
/datum/reagent/consumable/menthol.description: Alleviates coughing symptoms one might have.

/datum/reagent/consumable/cream_soda.name: Cream Soda
/datum/reagent/consumable/cream_soda.description: A classic space-American vanilla flavored soft drink.

/datum/reagent/consumable/sol_dry.name: Sol Dry
/datum/reagent/consumable/sol_dry.description: A soothing, mellow drink made from ginger.

/datum/reagent/consumable/shirley_temple.name: Shirley Temple
/datum/reagent/consumable/shirley_temple.description: Here you go little girl, now you can drink like the adults.

/datum/reagent/consumable/bungojuice.name: Bungo Juice
/datum/reagent/consumable/bungojuice.description: Exotic! You feel like you are on vacation already.

/datum/reagent/consumable/prunomix.name: Pruno Mixture
/datum/reagent/consumable/prunomix.description: Fruit, sugar, yeast, and water pulped together into a pungent slurry.

/datum/reagent/consumable/agua_fresca.name: Agua Fresca
/datum/reagent/consumable/agua_fresca.description: A refreshing watermelon agua fresca. Perfect on a day at the holodeck.

/datum/reagent/consumable/mushroom_tea.name: Mushroom Tea
/datum/reagent/consumable/mushroom_tea.description: A savoury glass of tea made from polypore mushroom shavings, originally native to Tizira.

/datum/reagent/consumable/toechtauese_ju.name: Töchtaüse Juice
/datum/reagent/consumable/toechtauese_ju.description: An unpleasant juice made from töchtaüse berries. Best made into a syrup, unless you enjoy pain.

/datum/reagent/consumable/toechtauese_sy.name: Töchtaüse Syrup
/datum/reagent/consumable/toechtauese_sy.description: A harsh spicy and bitter syrup, made from töchtaüse berries. Useful as an ingredient, both for food and cocktails.

/datum/reagent/consumable/strawberry_ban.name: strawberry banana smoothie
/datum/reagent/consumable/strawberry_ban.description: A classic smoothie made from strawberries and bananas.

/datum/reagent/consumable/berry_blast.name: berry blast smoothie
/datum/reagent/consumable/berry_blast.description: A classic smoothie made from mixed berries.

/datum/reagent/consumable/funky_monkey.name: funky monkey smoothie
/datum/reagent/consumable/funky_monkey.description: A classic smoothie made from chocolate and bananas.

/datum/reagent/consumable/green_giant.name: green giant smoothie
/datum/reagent/consumable/green_giant.description: A green vegetable smoothie, made without vegetables.

/datum/reagent/consumable/vanilla_dream.name: vanilla dream smoothie
/datum/reagent/consumable/vanilla_dream.description: A sweet vanilla smoothie that sparkles.

/datum/reagent/consumable/cucumberjuice.name: Cucumber Juice
/datum/reagent/consumable/cucumberjuice.description: Ordinary cucumber juice, nothing from the fantasy world.

/datum/reagent/consumable/cucumberlemona.name: Cucumber Lemonade
/datum/reagent/consumable/cucumberlemona.description: Cucumber juice, sugar, and soda; what else do I need?

/datum/reagent/consumable/mississippi_qu.name: Mississippi Queen
/datum/reagent/consumable/mississippi_qu.description: If you think you're so hot, how about a victory drink?

/datum/reagent/consumable/t_letter.name: T
/datum/reagent/consumable/t_letter.description: You expected to find this in a soup, but this is fine too.

/datum/reagent/consumable/hakka_mate.name: Hakka-Mate
/datum/reagent/consumable/hakka_mate.description: A Martian-made yerba mate soda, dragged straight out of the pits of a hacking convention.

/datum/reagent/consumable/coconut_milk.name: Coconut Milk
/datum/reagent/consumable/coconut_milk.description: A versatile milk substitute that's perfect for everything from cooking to making cocktails.

/datum/reagent/consumable/melon_soda.name: Melon Soda
/datum/reagent/consumable/melon_soda.description: A neon green hit of nostalgia.

/datum/reagent/consumable/volt_energy.name: 24-Volt Energy
/datum/reagent/consumable/volt_energy.description: An artificially coloured and flavoured electric energy drink, in lanternfruit flavour. Made for ethereals, by ethereals.

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/bitter.name: Bitters and Soda
/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/bitter.description: A simple beverage of soda water flavored with aromatic bitters. Soothes upset stomachs.

/datum/reagent/impurity/healing.name: Healing Impure Reagent
/datum/reagent/impurity/healing.description: Not all impure reagents are bad! Sometimes you might want to specifically make these!

/datum/reagent/inverse/healing.name: Healing Inverse Reagent
/datum/reagent/inverse/healing.description: Not all impure reagents are bad! Sometimes you might want to specifically make these!

/datum/reagent/impurity/healing/medicine.name: Insolvent Medicinal Precipitate
/datum/reagent/impurity/healing/medicine.description: A viscous mess of various medicines. Will heal a damage type at random

/datum/reagent/inverse/helgrasp.name: Helgrasp
/datum/reagent/inverse/helgrasp.description: This rare and forbidden concoction is thought to bring you closer to the grasp of the Norse goddess Hel.

/datum/reagent/inverse/helgrasp/heretic.name: Grasp of the Mansus
/datum/reagent/inverse/helgrasp/heretic.description: The Hand of the Mansus is at your neck.

/datum/reagent/impurity/libitoil.name: Libitoil
/datum/reagent/impurity/libitoil.description: Temporarilly interferes a patient's ability to process alcohol.

/datum/reagent/impurity/probital_failed.name: Metabolic Inhibition Factor
/datum/reagent/impurity/probital_failed.description: This enzyme catalyzes crashes the conversion of nutricious food into healing peptides.

/datum/reagent/peptides_failed.name: Prion Peptides
/datum/reagent/peptides_failed.description: These inhibitory peptides cause cellular damage and cost nutrition to the patient!

/datum/reagent/impurity/lentslurri.name: Lentslurri
/datum/reagent/impurity/lentslurri.description: A highly addicitive muscle relaxant that is made when Lenturi reactions go wrong.

/datum/reagent/inverse/ichiyuri.name: Ichiyuri
/datum/reagent/inverse/ichiyuri.description: Prolonged exposure to this chemical can cause an overwhelming urge to itch oneself.

/datum/reagent/impurity/aiuri.name: Aivime
/datum/reagent/impurity/aiuri.description: This reagent is known to interfere with the eyesight of a patient.

/datum/reagent/inverse/hercuri.name: Herignis
/datum/reagent/inverse/hercuri.description: This reagent causes a dramatic raise in the patient's body temperature. Overdosing makes the effect even stronger and causes severe liver damage.

/datum/reagent/inverse/healing/tirimol.name: Super Melatonin
/datum/reagent/inverse/healing/tirimol.description: This will send the patient to sleep, adding a bonus to the efficacy of all reagents administered.

/datum/reagent/inverse/healing/convermol.name: Coveroli
/datum/reagent/inverse/healing/convermol.description: This reagent is known to coat the inside of a patient's lungs, providing greater protection against hot or cold air.

/datum/reagent/inverse/technetium.name: Technetium 99
/datum/reagent/inverse/technetium.description: A radioactive tracer agent that can improve a scanner's ability to detect internal organ damage. Will poison the patient when present very slowly, purging or using a low dose is recommended after use.

/datum/reagent/inverse/healing/syriniver.name: Syrinifergus
/datum/reagent/inverse/healing/syriniver.description: This reagent reduces the impurity of all non medicines within the patient, reducing their negative effects.

/datum/reagent/inverse/healing/monover.name: Monover
/datum/reagent/inverse/healing/monover.description: A toxin treating reagent, that only is effective if it's the only reagent present in the patient.

/datum/reagent/inverse/penthrite.name: Nooartrium
/datum/reagent/inverse/penthrite.description: A reagent that is known to stimulate the heart in a dead patient, temporarily bringing back recently dead patients at great cost to their heart. Mildly toxic when inert in a patient.

/datum/reagent/impurity/mannitol.name: Mannitoil
/datum/reagent/impurity/mannitol.description: Gives the patient a temporary speech impediment.

/datum/reagent/inverse/neurine.name: Neruwhine
/datum/reagent/inverse/neurine.description: Induces a temporary brain trauma in the patient by redirecting neuron activity.

/datum/reagent/inverse/corazargh.name: Corazargh
/datum/reagent/inverse/corazargh.description: Interferes with the body's natural pacemaker, forcing the patient to manually beat their heart.

/datum/reagent/inverse/antihol.name: Prohol
/datum/reagent/inverse/antihol.description: Promotes alcoholic substances within the patients body, making their effects more potent.
